name: Milwaukee
operatingHours: The Hop streetcar (M-Line Intermodal Station–Burns Commons and L-Line Third Ward–Lakefront, five shared stops) runs 5:00 AM–midnight Mon–Fri, 7:00 AM–midnight Sat and 7:00 AM–10:00 PM Sun, every ~15–20 min. No overnight service.
fareInfo: The Hop is free on both lines; just board, no ticket needed. MCTS buses (for the airport, Pabst Mansion, the zoo and the ballpark) cost $2.75 per ride since Jan 2026, paid with the Umo app or card or cash, with fare capping at $8.25 a day and $33 a week. The Amtrak Hiawatha between Intermodal Station and the Airport station costs ~$5–10 (book on amtrak.com).

sights.name: Pabst Mansion
sights.note: The 1892 Flemish Renaissance home of beer baron Frederick Pabst, seen on guided tours of its carved-wood rooms and restored pavilion; about 2 km west of downtown along Wisconsin Avenue (bus, not on The Hop).
sights.hours: Guided tours ~10:00 AM–4:00 PM daily (Sun from ~noon); check site

sights.name: Milwaukee Art Museum
sights.note: Lakefront art museum known for Santiago Calatrava's winged Quadracci Pavilion, whose sunscreen opens and closes daily, with strong American, German Expressionist and folk-art holdings; near the L-Line Lakefront stop.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–5:00 PM Wed–Sun, Thu till 8:00 PM; closed Mon–Tue

sights.name: Harley-Davidson Museum
sights.note: Industrial-style campus in the Menomonee Valley tracing more than a century of Harley motorcycles, from the 1903 'Serial Number One' to custom choppers you can sit on; a 10-minute walk from Intermodal Station.

sights.name: Basilica of St. Josaphat
sights.note: A domed Polish basilica on the South Side built around 1900 partly from salvaged Chicago Post Office stone, with a richly painted interior under one of the world's largest copper domes.
sights.hours: ~10:00 AM–4:00 PM most days for visits; closed during Mass

sights.name: Milwaukee Public Market
sights.note: Indoor food hall in the Third Ward with seafood counters, Wisconsin cheese, spice stalls and cafes, plus an upstairs seating area; next to The Hop's Historic Third Ward stop.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–8:00 PM Mon–Sat, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Sun

sights.name: Lakefront Brewery
sights.note: Riverside craft brewery famous for its jokey, sing-along tours that end with tastings, and a beer hall serving a Friday fish fry; a 15-minute walk north of Burns Commons.
sights.hours: Beer hall ~11:00 AM–10:00 PM (Sun to ~6:00 PM); tours run through the day

sights.name: American Family Field
sights.note: Home of the Milwaukee Brewers, a retractable-roof ballpark famous for its tailgating lots, sausage race and Bernie Brewer's slide; about 5 km west of downtown.
sights.hours: Brewers home games ~Apr–Sep (Oct if in playoffs); ballpark tours on select days

sights.name: Milwaukee Public Museum
sights.note: Natural and human history museum with the walk-through 'Streets of Old Milwaukee', a rainforest and a planetarium; the Wells Street building closes for good on Jan 3, 2027, before the move to the new Nature & Culture Museum of Wisconsin.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, closed Tue; final day at this site Jan 3, 2027

sights.name: Milwaukee County Zoo
sights.note: Large zoo on the city's western edge with bonobos, polar bears, a big-cat area and a miniature train; about 20 minutes by car or MCTS bus from downtown.
sights.hours: ~9:30 AM–4:30 PM daily (longer hours in summer)

sights.name: Mitchell Park Domes
sights.note: Three beehive-shaped glass conservatories holding a desert, a tropical jungle and a seasonal flower show; tickets are sold at the door only.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM Sat–Sun; Show Dome closes ~10 days between shows

sights.name: Great Lakes Distillery
sights.note: Wisconsin's first distillery since Prohibition, making whiskey, gin and brandy, with tours and a tasting room in Walker's Point.
sights.hours: Tasting room ~noon–evening Tue–Sun; tours mostly on weekends

sights.name: Milwaukee RiverWalk
sights.note: A 3-mile riverside path linking the Beerline, downtown and the Third Ward, lined with public art, bars and boat docks; Pere Marquette Park is a good central start.

sights.name: Discovery World
sights.note: Hands-on science and technology museum on the lakefront with freshwater and saltwater aquariums and a replica tall ship; near the L-Line Lakefront stop.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–4:00 PM Wed–Sun (fall/winter); daily in spring and summer

sights.name: Pabst Theater
sights.note: An ornate 1895 opera house, still a working concert and comedy venue, with a gilded German Baroque auditorium; next to City Hall.
sights.hours: Open for shows; free public tours on select days

sights.name: Bronze Fonz
sights.note: A life-size statue of Happy Days' Arthur Fonzarelli, thumbs up, on the RiverWalk; a quick, free photo stop.

sights.name: North Point Lighthouse
sights.note: A restored 1888 lighthouse in Lake Park, the Olmsted-designed bluff park; climb the tower for views over Lake Michigan, then walk the ravine trails.
sights.hours: Museum ~Sat–Sun afternoons; Lake Park ~6:00 AM–10:00 PM

sights.name: Old World Third Street
sights.note: Old-fashioned downtown strip of German-flavored shops and taverns, including Usinger's sausage shop and the Spice House, near Fiserv Forum and the Deer District.
sights.hours: Street open 24 hours; shops ~10:00 AM–6:00 PM

railStations.name: Milwaukee Intermodal Station
railStations.note: Downtown's glass-fronted rail and bus terminal: Amtrak Hiawatha to Chicago (~1.5 hr), the Empire Builder and Borealis to Saint Paul, plus Greyhound and other intercity buses. The Hop M-Line starts at the front door.
railStations.hours: Station ~5:00 AM–~11:00 PM daily; Hiawatha departures ~6:00 AM–~8:00 PM

airports.name: Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport
airports.transitNote: Not on the streetcar map. The MCTS GreenLine bus runs from the terminal to downtown in ~35 min ($2.75); or take the free shuttle to the Milwaukee Airport rail station and ride the Amtrak Hiawatha ~10 min to Intermodal Station. Taxi or rideshare ~15 min.
airports.hours: GreenLine bus ~5:00 AM–~midnight; Hiawatha ~6 trains each way, ~7:00 AM–~9:30 PM
